title: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification
answer_text: We maintain a current SOC 2 Type II report issued annually by an independent auditor, plus an ISO 27001 certificate. Both are available under NDA through our trust portal.

title: Single sign-on and user provisioning
answer_text: We support SAML 2.0 single sign-on with any compliant identity provider, and automated user provisioning and deprovisioning through SCIM 2.0.

title: Encryption at rest and in transit
answer_text: All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3. Customer-managed encryption keys are available on enterprise plans through AWS KMS.

title: Penetration testing and vulnerability remediation
answer_text: An independent firm performs a full penetration test twice per year. Critical findings are remediated within 14 days and high findings within 30 days, tracked to closure in our vulnerability register.

title: Role-based access control and custom roles
answer_text: Administrators assign granular role-based access control, including custom roles that restrict record visibility by business unit, warehouse, or region.

title: REST API and webhook events
answer_text: Our documented REST API covers every object in the product, with OAuth 2.0 authentication, sandbox credentials, and webhook events for all record changes.

title: ERP connectors for SAP Oracle and NetSuite
answer_text: Prebuilt native connectors are available for SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, and NetSuite, covering purchase orders, invoices, and item master synchronization.

title: Real-time inventory visibility
answer_text: Inventory positions update in near real-time across every warehouse and third-party logistics location, with configurable refresh intervals down to five minutes.

title: Implementation methodology and timeline
answer_text: A standard implementation completes in 60 to 90 days from contract signature, covering discovery, configuration, integration, user acceptance testing, and go-live.

title: Historical data migration
answer_text: Our migration team imports historical shipment and order records through a validated staging process, with reconciliation reports produced before cutover.

title: Support coverage and severity response
answer_text: Support is staffed 24x7 across three regions. Severity one incidents receive a response within one hour and continuous work until service is restored.

title: Customer success staffing and business reviews
answer_text: Every enterprise customer is assigned a named customer success manager who runs quarterly business reviews covering adoption, open risks, and the roadmap.

title: Pricing structure and term commitments
answer_text: Subscription pricing is fixed for the committed term, including multi-year agreements up to three years. Volume discount tiers begin above 250 licensed users.

title: Sandbox and test environments
answer_text: Every customer receives a sandbox environment that mirrors production configuration, for testing integrations and validating release changes.
